pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which month comes right after "November"? (1 mark)
   A. Juni
   B. September
   C. Juli
   D. Dezember

2. If today is Mittwoch, what was yesterday (gestern)? (1 mark)
   A. Freitag
   B. Dienstag
   C. Donnerstag
   D. Montag

3. What does "spielen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to hear
   B. to play
   C. to sing
   D. to help

4. What does "der Geburtstag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. birthday
   B. balloon
   C. party
   D. candle

5. What number is "fünf"? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 12
   C. 15
   D. 5

6. Which word completes "Mit den Ohren ___ ich"? (1 mark)
   A. spreche
   B. sehe
   C. höre
   D. rieche

7. Which German word or phrase means "lamp"? (1 mark)
   A. das Zimmer
   B. die Gabel
   C. der Kühlschrank
   D. die Lampe

8. What is the plural of "die Gabel"? (1 mark)
   A. die Gabeler
   B. die Gabeln
   C. die Gabels
   D. die Gabel

9. What does "die Orange" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. lunch
   B. orange
   C. water
   D. potato

10. Which German word or phrase means "Sunday"? (1 mark)
   A. der Donnerstag
   B. der Montag
   C. der Sonntag
   D. der Tag

11. Which month comes right after "Mai"? (1 mark)
   A. März
   B. November
   C. Januar
   D. Juni

12. Which little word goes with the noun "Fisch"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. das
   D. der

13. What does "der Wind" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. rainbow
   B. wind
   C. rain
   D. thunderstorm

14. What does "über" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. behind
   B. under
   C. next to
   D. above

15. What does "die Kartoffel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. meat
   B. bread
   C. tomato
   D. potato

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write in German: "Today is Wednesday. Tomorrow is Thursday." (2 marks)

17. Write three German sentences describing a member of your family. (3 marks)

18. Write the German words with der, die or das for: fork, wall. (2 marks)

19. Give three German words or phrases for saying goodbye and say which is friendly and which is polite. (3 marks)

20. Write the German words with der, die or das for: finger, brothers and sisters, wind. (3 marks)

21. Explain how the umlaut changes the word Hand in the plural. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Dezember
   After November comes Dezember.

2. B — Dienstag
   The day before Mittwoch is Dienstag.

3. B — to play
   spielen means to play.

4. A — birthday
   der Geburtstag means birthday.

5. D — 5
   fünf is the number 5.

6. C — höre
   We hear with the ears.

7. D — die Lampe
   lamp in German is die Lampe.

8. B — die Gabeln
   The plural of die Gabel is die Gabeln.

9. B — orange
   die Orange means orange.

10. C — der Sonntag
   Sunday in German is der Sonntag.

11. D — Juni
   After Mai comes Juni.

12. D — der
   It is der Fisch, so the little word is der.

13. B — wind
   der Wind means wind.

14. D — above
   über means above.

15. D — potato
   die Kartoffel means potato.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Heute ist Mittwoch. Morgen ist Donnerstag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist jung. Sie ist lustig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence with capital letters and full stops.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Gabel, die Wand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tschüss (friendly), Auf Wiedersehen (polite), Bis morgen (see you tomorrow).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct phrase; award the marks only if the friendly and polite ones are identified sensibly.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Finger, die Geschwister, der Wind.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: a becomes ä, so die Hand becomes die Hände.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the vowel change and 1 mark for the plural.
